video_title: Derik Queen On Adjusting To NBA Life, His Year 2 Goals & Dream 1-On-1

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on the physical demands of his rookie NBA season
quotes.excerpt: the most challenging thing was the physicality
quotes.quote: The most challenging thing was the physicality. Everybody knew I tore a ligament in my wrist so I could not do arms, so I was four straight months of just all legs. But definitely the physicality and when you make a move, those guys are much stronger, much faster, so you have to be efficient in your movements.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on the importance of watching film to improve performance
quotes.excerpt: film don't lie, but when you are on the court, it may not look that bad
quotes.quote: I remember when we played the Pacers, they had scored probably three, four in a row and I thought it was not my fault. But the next day, we were in Houston, I watched film and it looked bad, it looked terrible. Film don't lie, but when you are on the court, it may not look that bad or it may not be a fault, but when you watch film, it is definitely hard to soak in, but it also helps.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on Derik Queen setting a tone of accountability
quotes.excerpt: I feel like you are setting the tone of accountability. It works its way through the locker room
quotes.quote: I feel like you are setting the tone of accountability. It works its way through the locker room because now everybody is going to want to see that and hold themselves accountable or whoever accountable because of just that. So that is something to consider. Anytime you feel like I need to see that play real quick, let me see it, do that. Use that to your advantage.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on managing his finances and supporting his inner circle
quotes.excerpt: we do look out for the people that was always there for us
quotes.quote: People come to me or go to her and my mother always say if they come to me, just send them to my mother. Or if they go to my mother, be like, Derik has to ask his financial advisor and just do whatever the case may be. But she already nipped that in the bud. We do look out for the people that was always there for us, but newcomers and consistent actors, we can't we can't cancel that out.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on his goals to improve as a three-point shooter
quotes.excerpt: one of my goals right now is to become a better three-point shooter
quotes.quote: One of my goals right now is to become a better three-point shooter. I call this dude, his name is Josh, he is actually from Houston, you might know his family, Winslow. Before me going to my college and then me going to my rookie year, we always get on the phone and he said give me seven, eight goals. But we haven't done that yet, but he is actually coming down next week. One of my goals is definitely becoming a three-point shooter, of course make the rookie All-Star game.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on Derik Queen learning from Jody Demars
quotes.excerpt: being surrounded by champion and Jody Demars is who you need to be sitting down with
quotes.quote: Being surrounded by champion and Jody Demars is who you need to be sitting down with and just soaking knowledge, bro. Having conversations with Jody, he is a very, very smart guy and that is my birthday brother, we got the same birthday. But having conversations with Jody, bro, is going to enhance your basketball IQ and take you to another place that you probably didn't think you can go.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the importance of asking for specific feedback
quotes.excerpt: what is it you see in my game that I am good at and I need to improve
quotes.quote: When you sit down, you say, hey, what is it you see in my game that I am good at and I need to improve? Because he has seen your game, I am sure he has studied your game and then it kind of gives you there because what like you said before with watching film. And I still recommend you still watch film, but what you see about your game and what you think about your game and then you have a guy like Jody who who evaluates a lot of players, take what he is saying to heart and then now you put your head down and you get to work.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on his dream one-on-one matchup against Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: my dream one-on-one matchup is probably Shaq
quotes.quote: My dream one-on-one matchup is probably Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on Derik Queen wanting to face Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: you can name anybody else, but you can't name Shaq
quotes.quote: You can name anybody else, but you can't name Shaq.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on Derik Queen's ambition to get dunked on by Shaq
quotes.excerpt: you want to get dunked on, so if that is your dream, that is your dream
quotes.quote: You want to get dunked on, so if that is your dream, that is your dream to get dunked on. Playing prime Shaq, Phoenix Celtics Shaq.
